room_rent.note: Room rent covered up to Sum Insured, except Suite or above category; pro-rata if higher than entitled

copayment.note: No mandatory base co-pay; optional Zone 2 selection triggers 20% co-pay in metro cities

sub_limits.note: Robotic surgery ₹1L sub-limit; maternity, mental disorder, LASER sub-limits apply

maternity.note: Maternity sub-limit ₹40k–₹2L by SI tier; floater/family-first only, not individual; up to 2 pregnancies

cumulative_bonus.note: Loyalty Additions +10% base SI/yr up to 100%; up to 200% with optional Enhanced Loyalty Additions

restoration.note: Re-fill reinstates up to 100% base SI; applies for same and different illness

ayush.note: Alternative treatment covered up to SI

ambulance.note: Network hospital up to SI; non-network capped ₹2,000/event. Air ambulance via emergency assistance

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery sub-limited to ₹1L on few procedures

consumables.note: Allowable consumables in inpatient; full non-medical not confirmed. VERIFY

global_cover.note: International coverage inbuilt on Gold/Platinum (worldwide excl USA/Canada); not on Silver. Extension optional add-on

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity individual-policy excluded; International cover Silver-tier not available; standard Excl01–18

optional_riders.display: Enhanced Loyalty Additions, Personal Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Cash, International coverage extension, Enhanced Geographical Scope
